title: Settings pages: no duplicated action labels, warnings out of the subtitle, Cloud Connection says its sentence once
body:
## Source

Walked on objectui main `8415d9f11`, the settings hub pages:

- Mail Delivery: the "Delivery" section ends with "Send test email" as a row label and "Send test email" as the button beside it; AI & Embedder repeats "Test connection / Test connection", "Reset to environment defaults / Reset to environment defaults", "Test embedder / Test embedder"; Knowledge and File Storage repeat "Test connection".
- File Storage's page subtitle is "Backend used for attachments, exports, and user uploads. ⚠ Switching adapter does not migrate existing files — files uploaded under the previous adapter become unreachable through the new one."; Knowledge's subtitle carries "⚠ Switching adapter does NOT migrate existing indices."; AI & Embedder's "Log full prompts" help text carries "⚠ May leak PII".
- Cloud Connection (`page/cloud_connection_settings`): the page description and the card body are the same sentence ("Connect this runtime to an ObjectStack control plane to browse your organization's private packages and install them here.").
- Installed Apps carries a "Note: The kernel API is additive only — uninstall removes the on-disk manifest …" paragraph under the empty state.

## Target

1. An action row has one label: the button carries it; the row's left side holds the one-line help ("Sends a message to the from address") or nothing.
2. Warnings leave subtitles and help text: a callout (amber, 13 px, icon) under the section they concern, rendered once.
3. Cloud Connection's card body says what the state is and what the button does; the page description stays the one sentence.
4. Installed Apps' kernel note becomes a tooltip on the Uninstall action, where it applies.

## File surface

The settings hub pages under `system/settings/*` in `packages/app-shell/src/console/`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/` pages for Cloud Connection and Installed Apps, `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: no settings page renders the same string as both a row label and a button label; each ⚠ sentence renders inside a callout element.
2. Screenshots of Mail, AI & Embedder, File Storage and Cloud Connection at 1280 px.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, `pnpm check:i18n` green.

## Constraints

- Settings keys, values and save behaviour do not change.

## Evidence

No screenshot; the measurements above and the page URLs are the evidence.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 second review pass: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the Studio pillars and all 43 Setup pages walked in the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en) with a 1280 × 900 re-check (zh). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed, verbatim: 「全部立卡」.</sub>
